title: Preserve per-path policy in a unique-blob digest prefilter (no κ)
body:
This takes Nick Petalas’s [PR6428 digest-search handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19361925). An opt-in unique-blob prefilter retains every matching alias and delegates final text/binary classification to the original Git grep. A representative’s verdict is unsafe: identical bytes can be text at one path and binary at another.

The new package is `research/pinned-digest-blob-prefilter`; shared scanners and CI are unchanged. It authenticates the exact PR6357/PR6428 source closure before intentional execution in temporary fixtures. The preservation proof is restricted to the exact positive fixed-string seam, readable stable Git objects/configuration/attributes and POSIX UTF8 paths; unsupported/recursive/error cases fall back.

Task: `replay-runtime`, `scope_status=changed`: the measured-acceleration card is narrowed to a path-safe reuse boundary, proof and controlled conformance, with a measured negative timing outcome. [Task card and next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e16fa4bf5ea361b0abe9cdf499491f55a18a5c7a/research/pinned-digest-blob-prefilter/TASK.json). Science froze at 23:23:37 UTC within the 60-minute session; at least the final 15 minutes are reserved for verification and handoff.

Evidence:
- Complete three-way primary report/CLI conformance: 26 rows, 22 stale, 13 frozen stale; 52 regular paths, 9 unique raw-blob requests, 15 aliases delegated to Git.
- Separately implemented, independently sealed native per-path oracle: 28 complete rows on a different history; 26 blob paths, 12 unique objects, 17 candidates and 13 accepted aliases. Actual representative-policy controls expose four false positives and ten false negatives.
- Same-fixture five alternating warm full-CLI trials: median 0.138180 s predecessor, 0.109483 s PR6428 reuse, 0.143418 s prefilter, with identical complete stdout/exits. The extra pass was **slower** here. Counts are explicit Python payload transfers, not physical I/O or decompression measurements.
- Normal/`-O` strict receipts, package metadata/runtime, commit byte/mode/source-history checks, export declared-input check, and read-only cold normal/`-O` replays passed. The cold export has no `.git`; Git itself is intrinsic. Static AI review found no unresolved material defect in this domain.

Commands (Python 3.12):
```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pinned-digest-blob-prefilter/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pinned-digest-blob-prefilter/oracle.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pinned-digest-blob-prefilter
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pinned-digest-blob-prefilter --check-source-history --check-modes
```
The optional `benchmark.py` repeats the controlled warm comparison and prints stdout only.

Source pins: PR6428 head `40591325403a9897ca95f642345742d17b1bd2a0`; canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; frozen four-file identities in `SOURCE-PINS.json`. Primary receipt SHA256 `87e6fc1f9663f8c55d22f1f267611f6fd438de07609c2c5ecf1f68da4c30d309`; oracle `82db963897be33591b489917ef9cdb578e5374d245abacf229b173ea6158515c`. Public tree `cb65aff219be1f9fef539f044a9af3fc13e59d91` equals the tested/exported tree.

Remaining: full exact canonical 154-row historical replay and a fair separately budgeted end-to-end benchmark; malformed-stream fault injection beyond the existing fallback wiring control; any recursive-submodule extension. No speedup, universal diagnostic equivalence, Windows lifecycle result, physical supplier admission or κ claim. Priority revision 8 / selected PR6030 and its five assumptions remain unchanged. Main and live overlap were refreshed before submission; sparse/hidden/unpublished/history gaps remain.

Credit: apoursh/Armin Pourshafeie and retained Anthropic Claude attribution (PR6319 scanner), ToikY/OpenAI Codex (PR6357 CR/LF/repository repairs), Nick Petalas (PR6428 unchanged-head reuse, benchmark and explicit next question), canonical helper contributors and Git developers. New work is ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; independent AI corroboration is not independent human review.

Coordination: [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362305). Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or frontier change requested.

Hosted checkout was synthetic PR test commit `bfb7d73520d33cb9442d299c651dcd5b4d2adee2`; its tree equals the frozen/public tree, not an actual merge. All seven optimized-Python corrupted-source/receipt rejection controls also passed on disposable copies.
